edges.reason: msg.sender is the implicit sender consumed by transfer()
msg.sender is used as the spender in transferFrom()
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against _owner for lock()
unlock() requires _previousOwner == msg.sender to restore ownership
unlock() depends on block.timestamp > _lockTime, a timestamp dependency
block.timestamp feeds the lock time computation
_lockTime is written from block.timestamp creating miner influenced access control
lock() stores the current owner into _previousOwner
unlock() reads _previousOwner for the permission and restore logic
_transfer triggers swapAndLiquify when the contract balance exceeds the threshold
the assignment bug forces the restore path that overwrites _liquidityFee
_transfer reads the tax fee state through the fee logic

_transfer requires that neither from nor to is blacklisted in _isBot

_takeLiquidity credits _takeOwned when the contract is excluded
_getRate calls _getCurrentSupply to obtain rSupply and tSupply
_getRate uses _takeTotal as the token supply side
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForETH on half of the balance
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity with the other half and the received ETH
